title: One line of $STEWARD_RUN_DIR/records.jsonl
description: A job may write any keys in its records. The keys declared here are reserved: when present they mean this and have this type, and Steward reads them. A record that violates a reserved key is noted in the run's manifest (record_errors) and that key is ignored; it is never silently dropped.

schema.description: Optional on records; when present it must be this.

weighted_tokens.description: Model tokens this record's work cost, in one unit for every job: input + output + 1.25 x cache_write + 0.1 x cache_read. Steward sums them over the run as its learned token cost. Integer or float.

provider.description: Whose quota weighted_tokens spent (Claude subscription vs Sol pool).

terminated.description: true when written during the TERM grace (the run hit max_minutes).

links.description: Backlinks: {tty_run}, {session} or {url} objects, full URLs and native ids only.
